description.value: Palki is a well-established Indian restaurant in North Vancouver, named after the ornate wooden carriage central to Indian wedding traditions—a nod to the restaurant's emphasis on cultural authenticity and atmosphere. It offers a full dine-in experience with distinctive decor, a daily lunch buffet, and takeout with online ordering. The menu spans butter chicken, lamb biryani, and a wide range of vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free dishes.

address.value: 116 East 15th Street, North Vancouver, BC V7L 2P9

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 50m; stands (3 spaces) at 60m; stands (3 spaces) at 72m; stands (3 spaces) at 72m; stands (3 spaces) at 77m; stands (3 spaces) at 85m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM phone number, address, and business identity. The menu page explicitly marks items as Vegan (Ⓥ) and Gluten Free (Ġ) and includes dedicated Vegetarian Specialties and Vegan menu sections. No bike parking, bike rack, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere on the website; the only parking reference is free underground car parking accessed via Eastern Avenue.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Palki Indian' but the website consistently refers to the business as 'Palki Restaurant' or 'Palki Indian Restaurant'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service Indian restaurant with takeout and a broad vegetarian/vegan/GF menu, making it a practical dining stop for touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes dedicated Vegetarian Specialties and Vegan sections; individual items are marked Ⓥ (Vegan) and Ġ (Gluten Free) throughout

wow_evidence: well-established Indian restaurant...daily lunch buffet...wide range of vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free dishes
